name: routing_holdout
description: Held-out questions for the Phase 9b query router: labels only, no evidence (not a retrieval set). Written and labelled before the router rules, from the intent definitions in retrieval/router.py, so router accuracy can be checked on questions the rules were not tuned on. Same author as the rules, so this is a sanity check, not an unbiased test. Intents: lookup = one fact stated in text; table = a value read from structured data (amount, count, share, ranking, list of rows); image = about visual content (photo, chart, scan, whiteboard, drawing); multi_hop = several facts combined (two-part question, a thing described instead of named, or a comparison).
